title: 时间与数量表达
goal: 听辨时间与数量，并根据明确条件计算时刻或金额。

points.label: 按已听条件确定时间或金额

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 时间与数量表达的教学内容及课程小测规格

body.p: 这类题先分清所问的是时刻、时长、数量还是价格。需要计算时，只用对话中说出的数字。

body.box: The bus leaves at nine and takes twenty minutes. → It arrives at nine twenty.

body.p: nine 是出发时刻，twenty minutes 是时长。两者相加，得到到达时刻。

cards.title: 易混数词
rows: We need thirteen chairs, not thirty.
The group has fourteen members, not forty.
The guide counted fifteen visitors, not fifty.
The class ordered sixteen maps, not sixty.
The hall has seventeen tables, not seventy.
The shop received eighteen boxes, not eighty.

cards.title: 时刻与时长
rows: The meeting starts at six o'clock.
half past 加整点，表示过了半小时。
The film begins at half past six.
分钟数加 to 加下一个整点，表示差几分到整点。
for 加一段时间，表示持续多久。
The film lasts for forty minutes.
开始时刻加时长，得到结束时刻。
It starts at six and lasts forty minutes, so it ends at 6:40.

cards.title: 单价与总价
rows: 总价减去已付的钱，得到余款。
结束时刻减开始时刻，得到时长。
开始时刻加时长，得到结束时刻。
A twenty-minute talk that starts at 3:00 ends at 3:20.

body.box:
A: How much is one notebook?
B: Three dollars each.
A: I'll take two.

How much do the two notebooks cost?
1. Three dollars.
2. Five dollars.
3. Six dollars.
4. Nine dollars.

body.p: each 表示每本 3 美元，two 表示买 2 本。3 乘 2 等于 6，即第三项。

lines.text: How many chairs do we need for the drawing class? I counted the names on the list, but another student joined this morning.
We'll need fourteen chairs in all. The teacher already has a chair.

items.stem: How many chairs are needed for the class?
items.why: We'll need fourteen chairs in all 说明一共要 14 把，即第二项。老师已经有椅子，不再加一把。

lines.text: When does the film begin tonight? I know the doors open at six, and I need to meet my friend before it starts.
The film begins at half past six. I'll see you at the entrance.

items.why: The film begins at half past six 说明六点半开场，即第三项。六点是开门的时间。

lines.text: How long will the train journey take? It leaves at two o'clock, and I need to tell my friend when to meet me.
The journey takes thirty minutes, so tell your friend the arrival time.

items.why: 两点出发，路上用 thirty minutes，所以两点半到达，即第四项。

lines.text: How many people signed up for the art trip? We reserved a bus for forty, but not every seat needs to be filled.
There are fifteen names on the list so far.

items.stem: How many people have signed up?
items.why: fifteen names on the list 表示已有 15 人报名，即第一项。forty 是大巴的座位数。

lines.text: When does the science talk start? I want to collect my ticket before it begins, and the ticket desk opens at six.
It starts at ten to seven. I'll wait by the desk.

items.why: It starts at ten to seven 表示差 10 分到七点开始，即六点五十分，第二项。

lines.text: How much are the postcards at the museum shop? I want two of the same design to send to my cousins.
They're four dollars each. The envelopes are included in that price.

items.stem: How much will the two postcards cost?
items.why: 每张 four dollars，买 2 张，共 8 美元，即第三项。信封不另收钱。

lines.text: The painting workshop starts at three o'clock. How long does it last? I need to arrange a ride home after the workshop.
It lasts for forty minutes, with all the materials provided.

items.why: 三点开始，持续 forty minutes，所以三点四十分结束，即第四项。

lines.text: How long is the boat trip around the island? The first trip leaves at eleven, and I'd like to plan lunch afterward.
The trip takes seventeen minutes. Tickets are sold beside the pier.

items.stem: How long is the boat trip?
items.why: The trip takes seventeen minutes 说明船程 17 分钟，即第一项。eleven 是第一班船的出发时刻。

lines.text: The room costs twelve dollars for the afternoon. I've already paid five dollars when I made the booking yesterday.
That's right. You can pay the rest at the desk today.

items.stem: How much remains to be paid?
items.why: 总价 12 美元，已付 5 美元，还要付 7 美元，即第二项。
